verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Gusto as a payroll/HR API platform with an MCP server for developers to interact with API/docs, but there is no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to end users from their payroll/HR data (e.g., analytics, anomaly detection, recommendations). Missing for 10: any in-product AI insights/suggestions feature, evidence of AI analyzing user data and surfacing recommendations, first-party or independent confirmation of such a capability.
